conditions.text: The vital OT systems hold their operational and application data on storage inside OT
That storage does not depend on IT-hosted file shares
A documented fallback keeps the data available during isolation

SEP-STOR-01.basis: split from the requirement text: localised OT-resident storage, independent of IT-hosted file shares, or a documented fallback

conditions.text: File transfer between IT and OT follows a defined, controlled pattern (for example a proxy with antivirus scanning)
No direct or ad hoc share access is used for transfer between IT and OT
OT pushes data outward to IT and external systems
IT and external networks do not pull data in from OT

SEP-STOR-03.basis: split from the requirement text: push data outward rather than allowing IT/external networks to pull data in from OT
